Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and hematuria, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
